name: submit_bug_analysis
description: Submit the root-cause analysis and the proposed code fix for the Jira bug. Call this exactly once.

summary.description: One or two sentences describing the bug in plain language.

root_cause.description: Technical root cause, referencing concrete classes/methods from the provided files.

affected_components.description: Classes, modules or endpoints affected by the bug.

fix_description.description: What the fix changes and why it resolves the root cause.

edits.description: Minimal code changes. Empty if no safe fix can be proposed from the provided code.

path.description: Repository-relative path, exactly as given in the <file path=...> tag (or a new file path).

old_text.description: Exact text copied verbatim from the file, including indentation, that occurs exactly once. Empty string only when creating a new file.

explanation.description: Why this specific change is needed.

testing_notes.description: How to verify the fix: tests added or to add, manual steps, edge cases.

confidence.description: Confidence that the edits fix the bug without regressions.

needs_human_input.description: True when the information or code provided is insufficient for a reliable fix.

open_questions.description: Questions for the developer or reporter.
